messages:
Sam: Heads-up — ACME POC kickoff. Need to align eval harness + security Q answers. Who can own golden dataset + scoring rubric? timeline: 2 weeks for initial run.
Maria: I can take golden dataset curation. Can you confirm primary use cases?
Devin: Primary use cases are: 1) customer support triage (intent classification + extract entities), 2) canned-response generation (short replies), 3) sensitive PII redaction check.
Alex: For scoring we should do multi-metric: intent F1 (>=0.88), response BLEU/ROUGE for generation (>=0.45 rouge1), and a precision-based PII-detection gate (no PII misses allowed in golden set).
Nina: Security Q from their InfoSec: encryption at rest, KMS, audit logs, SOC2 scope, data retention policy. I already started answers but need infra to confirm KMS details.
Sam: @Maria please prioritize dataset examples per use case. Aim for 150 gold items per use case (diverse edge cases).
Maria: Will do, planning to pull 120 from their shared sample corpus + 30 synthetic hard cases.
Devin: For prompts, we should include prompt templates + negative prompts for adversarial tests. Also seed a small set of ambiguous queries that require context.
Alex: Proposed scoring JSON for the harness (rough sketch):
```json
{
  "intent_threshold": 0.88,
  "generation_rouge1": 0.45,
  "pii_miss_tolerance": 0,
  "regression_gate": "fail_if_drop>0.03"
}
```
Sam: That looks good. For regression gates we want: if any metric drops >3% vs baseline -> block rollout. Baseline will be current model run on gold set.
Nina: Security blocker: ACME's legal wants a signed DPA + proof of kms integration. I can attach draft DPA but need confirmation that Private deployment supports customer KMS (yes/no).
Alex: Dedicated supports bring-your-own-KMS in Private mode; Hosted has envelope encryption integration but not BYOK. I'll add a short note for sales playbook.
Maria: ETA on gold set: 4 business days. I'll push to the eval harness repo and tag `acme/golden-v1`.
Devin: Eval harness will need expected outputs format: JSONL with fields: id, prompt, expected_intent, expected_entities, expected_reply. I'll add a converter script.
Sam: Who can run the first pass and generate baseline numbers? @eval-bot can you queue a run after Maria pushes?
eval-bot: queued run scheduled once branch `acme/golden-v1` appears in `evals/acme`. Sending results to thread.
Nina: On pricing: ACME asked for a blended rate for POC + potential scaling. Sales wants a conservative estimate: hosted per-token during POC, then we propose dedicated commit. I'll draft numbers today.
Alex: Also flag quantization/latency trade-offs in the POC plan — they will test sub-200ms 1k token streams. We should capture latency profiles per model variant.
Maria: Quick question — for PII gate, do we use their labeler or our internal redaction check?
Devin: Use both: trust their labels for gold set, but run our internal redaction detector as a production-style check. Gate uses our detector (strict).
Sam: OK next steps recap:
- Maria: deliver gold dataset + push `acme/golden-v1` (4bd)
- Devin: converter + prompt templates + adversarial set (3bd)
- Alex: write scoring rubric + latency profile script (2bd)
- Nina: finish security answers + confirm KMS option (2bd)
- Eval-bot: run baseline once gold pushed
Please update the shared doc and ping when artifacts are in. :thumbsup:
Maria: Will update `sales/00-acme-poc` doc and ping here when ready.
Nina: I'll loop Legal and infra this afternoon.
Alex: +1 on timeline. If baseline fails any gate, we'll run quick antipode: try quantized variant and rerun.
Sam: Great. If anything blocks (security or pricing) escalate to me and @Devin.
Maria: PR opened: `acme/golden-v1` -> awaiting CI.
eval-bot: baseline run started (job 5427). Results will post as comment.
Sam: Thanks all, keeping this thread as the single source for the harness alignment.
